project_type: Python FastAPI backend + Next.js 16 (React 19) frontend, uv monorepo workspace
build_system: uv workspace (root pyproject.toml), hatchling per-package. Frontend: Next.js 16.3.7 with npm scripts. Alembic migrations live at packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/, invoked from repo root via `alembic -c alembic.ini`.
test_framework: pytest>=8.2.0 with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto) for backend. No test suite configured for frontend yet.
build_command: cd api && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload (dev). For type-check: uv run mypy api/src. For lint: uv run ruff check .
test_command: uv run pytest (from repo root) — no test files exist yet; run will collect 0 tests but must not error. Dashboard: cd dashboard && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. From repo root: `uv run ruff check api/src packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared` — must pass. 2. `uv run python -c 'from synthetiq_shared.models import Membership, InviteToken, LegalEntity; print("models OK")'` — must print 'models OK'. 3. `cd dashboard && npm run build` — must complete without TypeScript errors. 4. Alembic: `uv run alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head` — must apply without error on a fresh SQLite DB.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Alembic migration .py files under packages/synthetiq-shared/alembic/versions/ must be committed. Dashboard .next/ build output is gitignored.
environment_constraints: Never restart the API server process — edits are hot-reloaded in dev. No pytest tests exist yet so `uv run pytest` will return exit 5 (no tests collected) — treat as passing. Next.js 16 (next@16.3.7) with React 19 — uses App Router; read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ if unsure about APIs. Do NOT use `find` or Unix grep — use PowerShell Get-ChildItem / Select-String.
contribution_requirements: Phase 0 is already committed on dev branch. All work goes on dev. Commits must be local only — never push. Migration must be non-destructive: no DROP or NOT NULL without a backfill strategy. Remove Base.metadata.create_all() from api/src/main.py (replace with Alembic-only). The companies router (_COMPANIES_DB in-memory dict) must be retired. The _RUNS_DB in-memory list in orchestrator.py must be replaced with WorkflowRun DB queries.
key_patterns: ORM models live in packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/models/organization.py (AuctionRecord, BidRecord, AuditRecord, EscrowPORecord, Form1Record, Organization, User, WorkflowRun, Schedule, DataSource are all in that one file). AgentConfiguration is in models/agent_config.py. Models __init__.py exports them all. Primary keys use String(64) not UUID type. org_id FK is String(64) referencing organizations.org_id. FastAPI deps use Depends(get_current_user) -> CurrentUser = Annotated[dict, ...]. Routes use assert_same_org() from rbac.py for cross-tenant guard. Services use async SQLAlchemy sessions via get_db_session() context manager. Dashboard services extend BaseService, call this.request<T>(). CompanyContext.tsx wraps layout.tsx (CompanyProvider > SessionProvider). useServices() hook in useServices.ts instantiates all service classes bound to token.
directory_structure: repo root: api/ (FastAPI, src/routes/ src/middleware/ src/services/ src/utils/), packages/synthetiq-shared/ (shared ORM, Alembic, config), dashboard/ (Next.js 16 App Router, app/lib/contexts/ app/lib/services/ app/lib/types/ app/lib/hooks/), worker/ (Temporal workers), mcp/ (MCP server), simulator/, mocks/, deploy/
